description: What is this occupation? Given a SOC or O*NET-SOC code, answers two records side by side, never merged: O*NET's (its title, every knowledge, skill, ability, work activity and work style item with importance and level, wage, outlook, five related occupations with how many there are, reported job titles, and when it was fetched) and the occupation record (description, typical education, certifications, five related occupations with how many there are, and its programs). A retired SOC follows O*NET's recorded replacement, and the answer says so. An occupation neither record holds is stated, never filled in.

soc.description: An occupation code (SOC, e.g. 29-1141, or O*NET-SOC, e.g. 29-1141.00)
